Never got the report and when we hopelessly called center post 2 PM no one picked up. This is an extremely unprofessional and shameless behaviour. Imagine if a person is in emergency and if he depends on center like this!
Anyways went to a different diagnostic center to do CBC and got report within matter of minutes.. I wasted my time and money and regret going to this center. Please go to another center where they know how important the reports are for patients. Beware and do not get duped!
